title: Honeylove Bra Reviews: What 3,000+ Customers Say About Fit, Support and Comfort
summary: Top bra reviews from over 3000+ Honeylove customers.See what real customers say about Honeylove's fit, support, and all-day comfort.
body_markdown:
There is a particular theme that shows up over and over in Honeylove's reviews. One customer calls it her donation pile. Another describes drawers full of no-wire bras that promised the world and a great fit. A third says she spent thousands of dollars trying to find a bra that both fits and is comfortable. These are women who have already tried the wireless category and been let down by it, several times, at full price.


Across 3,685 reviews of 13 bra styles, collected between January 2025 and July 2026, the single most repeated story isn’t about softness or color. It’s about a woman who wore underwire for decades, assumed wireless could not hold her up, tried it anyway, and realized she was wrong.


The proof is in the reviews. We've


organized them by the decision a shopper is actually making: whether wireless can support her, whether it holds at her cup size, which style suits what she needs, and whether the price makes sense.


## Wireless bras that support like underwire


The most common review is written by someone who did not expect to be writing it.


★★★★★


“I've been an underwire wearer for decades. Ive tried non underwire bras but have not been happy with the support, front and side. They've all ended up in my donation pile. I was curious about this brand and finally decided to give it a try. Wow!!! I am sold. I am so surprised with the front and side supports and the bottom front does not flip up or ride up!!!!!!!”


May K.


·[CrossOver Contour Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-contour-bra) · Size 34DD(E)


★★★★★


“Life long underwire gal here. For the last five years, I have been searching for a non-underwire alternative that can properly support my now almost elderly 42DD girls. While some bras I have found are comfortable, none provided anywhere near the support and lift of traditional underwire bras.”


Bethanne W.


·[CrossOver Contour Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-contour-bra) · Size 42DD(E)


★★★★★


“I have never worn a bra that was comfortable, made my breasts look good under clothes, and actually fit correctly > all in one bra! Normally I modify the fit before I can wear them too. Not this bra. This bra was perfect out of the bag. I'm still stunned.”


Anonymous


·[CrossFlex Activity Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossflex-bra) · Size S+


★★★★☆


“Since I stopped wearing underwire bras I've found it difficult to find a supportive bra. Honeylove is the first one that I've found that is comfortable and supportive all day long.”


Anonymous


·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size 1X


★★★★★


“I bought the crossover bra feeling sceptical. This is based on my previous experiences of wasting a lot of money buying bras from other retailers that were ill fitting and either offered support but with the discomfort of wires digging in or comfort but no support or shape enhancement. This crossover bra did not disappoint.”


Anonymous


·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size 3X


★★★★★


“I'd heard good things about Honeylove, especially for women who are abundantly blessed. Support for large breasts usually involves underwire or, if not, 'no underwire' bras with sadistically firm bands and straps that might as well BE underwire. I ordered this bra with hope but given previous experiences, was prepared to be let down. Instead, I have a bra that offers modest lift and shaping without making me feel like I'm in a cage. I'm a convert!”


Anonymous


·[SoftForm Pullover Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/softform-pullover-bra) · Size 3X+


★★★★★


“I put off purchasing initially because yes the price can be intimidating. However, after that first CloudEmbrace purchase, I couldn't stop telling all the women around me how amazing it felt. Now I have 4 and treat them like the gold they are!”


Anonymous


·[CloudEmbrace Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/cloudembrace-bra) · Size 34B


★★★★★


“In the 62 years of my life, wearing a bra, this is the most comfortable and supportive bra I have ever purchased. I absolutely LOVE this bra.”


Anonymous


·[Silhouette Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/silhouette-bra) · Size Large


★★★★★


“I wanted what was advertised - a bra that you can forget you have it on... Superb comfort, smooth profile front and back, a good t-shirt bra. I have been an underwire wearer but I don't miss the hardware with this bra.”


Anonymous


·[V-Neck Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/v-neck-bra) · Size 36DD


★★★★★


“I looked at the reviews for the Honeylove Crossover Bra for several weeks before ordering - have no idea why I waited so long. If you are looking for support without a wire, and amazing comfort, this is the bra to order.”


Donna M.


·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size Large


★★★★☆


“The most comfortable bra I have ever worn! Support is pretty good, just not quite as good as I had hoped for my old lady body.”


Pamela H.


·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size XL


★★★★★


“We have to be realistic though, this bra is not going to give the support of its underwire counterparts. However, there is really good support. I love it! HoneyLove is my go to bra.”


Robbin Q.


·[X Balance Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/xbalance-bra) · Size 38DD(E)


### What the reviews reveal


A wire is a rigid arc that transfers breast weight into the ribcage at two points. Take it out, and most brands compensate the cheap way: by tightening the band and thickening the straps until the bra grips hard enough to stay put. That is the design the reviewer above described as a cage, and it's part of the reason why so many wireless bras end up in the donation pile.


Honeylove replaces the wire rather than removing it. A bonded cradle sits under the bust and does the lifting a wire would do, without a hard edge. Flexible boning runs up the sides, so the sides hold their height instead of collapsing inward when the wearer moves. The load spreads across a wider band and wider wings rather than concentrating at two points.


## Support that holds at DD, DDD and G cups


Full-bust bra wearers are the hardest group to satisfy without a wire, and they are the loudest group in the Honeylove dataset.


★★★★★


“I wear a 38DDD and have tried many non-underwire bras and always had to go back to underwire due to lack of support ( even though the underwire was uncomfortable) . I only ordered one bra in order to try it out. The support is terrific, the lace like extension on the outside of the cups ensures everything looks even. The stave on the taller sides keep everything in place. The bra does all this with great comfort and lightness—barely realize I have it on.”


Beverly R.


·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size 2X


★★★★★


“I have large heavy breasts and wear a 38D. For years I wore underwire bras for support and minimizers. I never found a bra that did everything until now. The soft form bra has no wire but supports my large breasts. The wide straps and thick back are comfortable and weightless.”


Paula D.


·[SoftForm Pullover Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/softform-pullover-bra) · Size XL


★★★★☆


“I ordered the Honeylove Silhouette bra in a 36G since that's the largest cup size available, even though I normally wear an H cup... It's surprisingly comfortable and still holds everything up well despite not having any underwire. It's actually more comfortable than any underwire bra I've ever owned, and more supportive than any other wireless bra I've tried.”


Maria A.


·[Silhouette Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/silhouette-bra) · Size M++


★★★★★


“I have been large chested my whole life!!! I have never loved a bra more than yours! The straps are the best I have ever seen. The material is comfortable and the fit is amazing. I'm currently 42 DD and I love how your bra fits. I am finally comfortable in my clothing!”


MaryEllen O.


·[SoftForm Pullover Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/softform-pullover-bra) · Size 1X+


★★★★★


“I also have shoulder issues (I'm 71) and these bras are so well designed that the weight of my 38 DDD breast do not rest solely on my shoulders, but seem very well distributed on all points, giving me such relief from pain. I consider these bras an investment worth having.”


Marci M.


·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size 1X+


★★★★★


“I am (per bra measurers) a 38G, and this fit me perfectly and is comfortable throughout the day. Well worth the money.”


Anonymous


·[SoftForm Pullover Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/softform-pullover-bra) · Size 2X


★★★★★


“My mom who is 83 was having a hard time finding a bra that would fit her DDDs but her smaller frame. We have gone through a lot from bali to soma to underoutfit to amazon and NOTHING has worked until now. She loves the fit and it's extremely comfortable.”


Anonymous


·[CloudEmbrace Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/cloudembrace-bra) · Size 38DDD(F)


★★★★★


“All previous bras I have tried I cannot wait to get them off at night. The girls are screaming to be released. Honeylove's product (silhouette)is different, offering sold support and still being comfortable. As a DD, this is important and rare.”


Anonymous


·[Silhouette Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/silhouette-bra) · Size S+


★★★★★


“I am 67 and had been wearing an underwire bra for years. 36DD . This crossover contour bra is so comfortable and fits great . I ended up with the 34 Dd . The36 stuck out a little on the side so I reordered the 34 Dd. No gaps. A great fit . Returns were easy .”


Ellen


★★★★★


“I have been struggling for years to find a bra that offers good support. I have purchased 10 honey love bras. The best is the Balance and this Cross Flex Activity. The side support is just perfect. I wear this to work all the time. For the busiest shift at the hospital for busty women, this is a must.”


Lorielin S. R.


·[CrossFlex Activity Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossflex-bra) · Size 2X


### What the reviews reveal


Notice what these reviewers credit: Beverly R. points to the taller sides. Paula D. points to the wide straps and thick back. Marci M. describes weight distributed across all points rather than sitting on her shoulders. None of them mentions the cup.


That is the mechanism. At DD and above, the band carries roughly 80% of the load, and the sides stop the breast tissue migrating outward. Honeylove builds a wide underband with a four-prong closure, tall side panels stiffened with flexible boning, and wider straps than most wireless bras use. The support comes from the architecture around the bust, not from padding inside it.


## Which style is right for what you need


Honeylove makes 13 bra styles, and if there’s one thing reviews show, it's that there’s a perfect style for every breast shape and use case.


★★★★★


“After my stroke 10 months ago I was still unable to put on a regular bra. One of my hands was affected and I was unable to close a bra. I first tried cotton sports bras that I could pull over my head but the cotton material bunched up under my clothes and gave me one big uniboob. The Honeylove bra is the answer to my problem. Easy over my head, smooth ,defined , and extremely comfortable.”


KATHARYNE R.


·[SoftForm Pullover Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/softform-pullover-bra) · Size 2X+


★★★★☆

“The band is wide enough to not cut into you, but not too wide to that it rolls. The straps are not padded, but again wide enough that they are comfortable and don't cut into your shoulders... I don't think they completely do away with "uniboob" as an underwire does, but they help more than all other non-wired bras I have tried, and I have tried dozens!”


Pamela H.


·[X Balance Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/xbalance-bra) · Size 42DDD(F)

“I am large breasted and continually have problems with "uni-boob" and the band under my breasts rolling. This bra gets 98 percent of it right! I feel supported and the band doesn't roll.”

·[X Balance Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/xbalance-bra) · Size 36C

“I wear a D cup and while the honey love bras were extremely comfortable, they looked more uniboob than I liked. The cloudEmbrace bra is extremely comfortable and fits close at the center of the bra. Plus the underwire is so padded you almost don't know there is a wire there. No irritation.”

## Straps that stay on your shoulders


Slipping straps show up in the reviews as a problem women had given up on solving.


★★★★☆


“I bought it because I wanted a bra that I didn't have to continually fix the straps after falling off my shoulders. I achieved that goal with this bra.”


Margaret M.


·[Silhouette Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/silhouette-bra) · Size 1X


★★★★★


“I have a skin condition that causes bleeding from bras and my shoulders never keep straps up. I'm 61 and gravity isn't my best friend, Betsie with HoneyLove is! ... I love it and wore it all day and never had to pull my straps up or adjust due to causing sore spots!!”


Lisa G.


·[SoftForm Pullover Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/softform-pullover-bra) · Size 3X


★★★★★


“The X construction keeps the straps from sliding off my shoulders. And the cups 42DD, fit when I stepped down from a 44DD... If you have a tummy that protrudes, the wide band ensures the fit from riding up.”


Jane L. D.


·[X Balance Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/xbalance-bra) · Size 42DD(E)


★★★★★


“Best bra I ever wore as a senior. Wonderful support. Straps do not slip.”


Patricia


·[CrossOver V-Neck Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-v-neck-bra) · Size Medium

“My shoulders are narrow but these straps stay in place. And magically, they keep from bunching up back bulges too. This bra is a winner.”


Karen

★★★★★


“I'm 73 and didn't think I needed to buy new bras any more. But I heard so much about the comfort of Honeylove, I decided to treat myself. Plus, no more straps sliding off my shoulders!”


Sally


·[CrossOver V-Neck Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-v-neck-bra) · Size Small

### What the reviews reveal


Straps slip for two reasons: the band is not carrying enough of the load, so the straps are doing a job they were not built for, and the strap anchor points sit too far apart for the wearer's shoulder width.


Honeylove addresses both. The wide band and four-prong closure take the weight off the straps to begin with. The straps themselves are wider than the category norm, which spreads pressure instead of concentrating it in a groove. And every CrossOver style converts to a crossback, which pulls the anchor points inward for narrow or sloped shoulders. Three of the reviewers above mention narrow shoulders specifically, and the crossback option is what they are describing.


## Bands that stay put through the day


The band is where wireless bras usually fail. Honeylove reviewers describe the opposite phenomenon.


★★★★★


“Any non-underwire bra I have ever tried (over a dozen at this point), the band always rolls up or bends in some way - not Honeylove. It stays put and does its job beautifully.”


Bethanne W.


★★★★★


“I have ordered wireless bras before, and they would not stay put. I was constantly tugging them back down after raising my arms. Would these wireless bras behave the same way? Not at all! They stay right where they should, but with greater comfort than underwires.”


Sarah H.


★★★★★


“I tested them by lifting my arms straight up and jumping up and down, in the privacy of my own home so as to not shock anyone, and the bra stayed put, it did not ride up, and my breasts did not come out.”


VICTORIA S.


★★★★★


“Stays put no slipping and sliding and the straps are the same.”


Anonymous


★★★★★


“It does not ride up, stays in place.LOVE,LOVE, LOVE!!”


Anonymous


·[CrossFlex Activity Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossflex-bra) · Size Large


★★★★★


“the band is very comfortable, and stays put when moving your arms.”


Donna D.


·[X Balance Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/xbalance-bra) · Size 34C


★★★★★


“the best part for me is the bottom of the bra. It lands right under my breasts and does not extend underneath... For me all other bras extend too far underneath my breasts and then roll up which makes it very uncomfortable.”


Patricia


★★★★★


“You can customize it to fit yourself perfectly with the clasp adjustments. It stays in place.”


Anonymous


·[CrossFlex Activity Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossflex-bra) · Size Medium


### What the reviews reveal


A band rides up when it cannot resist the upward pull of the cups. Narrow elastic bands fold over on themselves, and once folded they climb. That is the mechanic behind every review that describes tugging a wireless bra back down after raising the arms.


Honeylove's underband is wide enough to resist folding, and the four-prong closure spreads the tension across more surface so it does not concentrate into a rolling edge. Flexible boning at the sides holds the vertical structure, which is what stops the whole garment migrating up the ribcage.


## Smooth lines across your back and underarms


What a bra does under a fitted top is the reason many of these women were shopping in the first place.


★★★★★


“The fit was perfect, and there were no bulges or lumpy skin in the underarm area. The straps have enough width to make them very comfortable.”

·[CrossOver Lace Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/lace-crossover-bra) · Size S+

“The crossover bra is so comfortable and provides full coverage under the arms and back. So nice to not have to worry about the shoulder straps falling.”

·[CrossOver Contour Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-contour-bra)


★★★★★


“The molded cups are smooth and invisible under shirts. The cups are large enough that there is no spillover which I appreciate.”


Pamela H.


★★★★★


“No more spillage of side boob, and yes, it is VERY, VERY comfortable and worth every penny.”


Connie D.


·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size Small


★★★★★


“I saw an ad for a particular Honeylove bra and it seemed to answer all my issues: not wanting to turn the bra around to hook it up, deep enough to cover side bulges nicely, lift without tightness, wide straps that don't feel like straps”


Rachel R.


★★★★★


“The cup fit and side coverage is perfect. I no longer have to try different brands of bras anymore.”


Anonymous


★★★★★


“The side coverage is great. The padded cups are form fitting-they don't gape at the top and the padding is just the right amount for smooth coverage.”


Anonymous


·[CloudEmbrace Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/cloudembrace-bra) · Size 38B


★★★★★


“Love the material and support without wire. Feels comfy but doesn't look frumpy so still gives me good shape.”


Anonymous


·[SoftForm Pullover Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/softform-pullover-bra) · Size Medium


★★★★☆


“No bra lines was what I was looking for and this bra delivers!”


Anonymous


### What the reviews reveal


Smoothing across the back is a matter of surface area and edge treatment. A narrow band with a tight elastic edge creates a compression line and pushes tissue above and below it. Widen the band, widen the wings, and soften the edge, and the same tissue redistributes across a larger area instead of being displaced into a ridge.


Honeylove's wings extend further toward the underarm than most bras, and the side panels sit taller. That is the design several reviewers describe as high under the arms, and it is doing two jobs at once: containing the bust from the side, and eliminating the gap where a shorter side panel would let tissue escape.


## Bras that keep up with workouts and warm weather


The CrossFlex is the one style built specifically for movement, but it isn’t the only Honeylove bra reviewers take to Pilates and the tennis court.


****


★★★★★


“I usually have a very hard time finding a good workout bra for my 38D's. If they're comfortable, then it doesn't have good support. I finally got lucky with the Crossflex Activity bra! So comfortable, it fits like a dream! And holds the girls in place during all workouts, including bouncing on my rebounder.”

“This crossflex activity bra is so comfortable I forget I'm wearing it. Its super flattering and almost invisible under clothes and supportive even while I'm riding horses, doing barn chores and grocery shopping.”

·[CrossFlex Activity Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossflex-bra) · Size Small

“This bra exceeds my expectations. Many of my prior sports bras were stiff, constricting. This one offers all round comfortable, shaping support and releases moisture generated from strenuous activities.”

★★★★★


“I attend a Pilates class filled with women around my age that have been wearing an under wire during workout. They have become followers one after another and have never been happier. The thick straps provide the needed support.”


Patricia M.


·[SoftForm Pullover Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/softform-pullover-bra) · Size S+


★★★★★


“I've been wearing these for about 10 days now. Very comfortable, even in the heat and humidity... These are MUCH easier to put on and to take off even when I am sweaty!”

★★★★★

“It's hard to find a good fit in sweaty Florida that gives comfort, and lift without wires, and adjustable straps for those of us who are not the same size on both sides! Crossflex is my bra.”

“I'm in my 60's, an avid tennis player (I've nursed 3children so the girls need hiding and the thin padding does the job under those clingy tennis shirts), and still very active working on my landscaping and gardening. A lot of sweating”

### What the reviews reveal


The CrossFlex is built as a bridge between an everyday bra and a sports bra, and reviewers treat it as exactly that. It hooks at the back rather than pulling over the head, which means the band tension is adjustable across four positions instead of fixed. For anyone with shoulder or hand mobility limits, that is the difference between wearable and not.


## Comfort through surgery, nursing and every change after


A seam runs through Honeylove reviews that has little to do with shopping. Women describe finding a bra that works after their bodies changed, sometimes drastically.


★★★★☆


“In 2018 I was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. I underwent a double mastectomy and reconstruction. Since then I have been searching for a bra that was comfortable and didn't cut into me... It took me almost 8 years and a lot of wasted money to find Honeylove. The support is there without digging in, the material is soft and comfortable, and for the first time in my life I don't want to pull my bra off at 5:00 everyday.”


Karen


★★★★★


“I'm a survivor! I had a left mastectomy in September. For those who experienced this the struggle goes far beyond the surgical pain... I finally found it! The Honeylove Cloud embrace is my pick! Thank you for helping me feel normal again”


Alisa


·[CloudEmbrace Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/cloudembrace-bra) · Size 38C


★★★★★


“I was diagnosed with breast cancer 5 years ago and after finishing my treatment I was told to never wear a underwire bra again. I purchased so many VS wireless bras but they wear so uncomfortable and hurts in certain areas. I hated wearing a bra altogether... Needless to say, I have found my lifetime forever bra.”


Denise


★★★★★


“I recently had a lift & implants after 5 kids & breastfeeding. My focus for bras post surgery were freedom & no more underwire!... because I had surgery, my natural shape is the breast and not the bra. These have also provided a superb amount of support”


Amy M.


·[CrossOver Lace Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/lace-crossover-bra) · Size Medium


★★★★★


“I am an older (71) lady who 20 some years ago had a breast reduction. I have since been searching for a bra I could wear all day without feeling like I was being tortured.....no underwires, just pain. These bras are amazing! The support is perfect, no binding, no digging”

·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size XL

“Had a breast reduction in July of this year. I cannot tell you how many bras that I have bought. I am so impressed with the quality of the crossover bra... At almost 65 years old I now have the confidence to enjoy life and feel confident in myself.”

·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra)

Underwire bothered my scar but I needed some support to make my chest look symmetrical with my new prosthetic. I tried many versions of non-underwire bras and this is the first one that is comfortable, holds everything at attention, and makes me still feel sexy.”


Anonymous


·[CrossOver Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) · Size 1X

“Since losing a significant amount of weight, I needed new bras... The support this bra gives in incredible. I was worried about the thinner straps, but they do not dig in one single bit! I have purchased 6 (so far)”

·[Silhouette Bra](https://www.honeylove.com/products/silhouette-bra) · Size Medium

### What the reviews reveal


Wireless construction is not a style preference for these customers. After a mastectomy, reconstruction or reduction, a rigid wire sits directly on scar tissue, and many are told outright not to wear one again. The options that remain are usually medical-looking or shapeless, which is why Karen spent eight years looking.


What makes Honeylove bras work in that context is that the support does not come from a hard component. The bonded cradle distributes lift across a soft surface, and the tall side panels contain without pressing on a single line. Several reviewers also mention the crossback conversion, which helps when reconstruction has left the bust sitting lower or wider than before.


## Why customers say it's worth the price


★★★★★

### What the reviews reveal


Almost every review contains a before: drawers full of no-wire bras, thousands of dollars spent, eight years of searching, six bras donated, discounted bras that always had issues. The comparison these women are making is not one Honeylove bra against one cheaper bra. It is one Honeylove bra against the accumulated cost of everything that did not work.


That is the honest case for the price. A $69 bra worn several times a week for two years is cheaper per wear than four $30 bras that sit in a drawer, and the reviewers making the point have the drawer to prove it.


The construction is where the money goes: a bonded cradle instead of a wire, flexible side boning, four-prong closure, wider wings, and premium four-way stretch fabric.

## Honeylove bra reviews FAQ


Are Honeylove bras good for large busts?


The reviews at 38DDD, 40DD, 42DD, 42DDD and 38G are consistently positive, with reviewers crediting the wide band, tall side panels and wide straps rather than the cups.


Do Honeylove bras give a uniboob?


The CrossOver and X Balance use construction to add definition. The CloudEmbrace and CloudLift with CloudWire include a padded wire and a centre gore, and reviewers who wanted more separation say that is where they landed.


Which Honeylove bra is best for wide-set or close-set breasts?


Wide-set wearers tend to want a wider center and a cup that pulls inward; close-set wearers usually want a narrower gore and a lower centre. See Honeylove's guidance on


[wide-set](https://www.honeylove.com/blogs/bra-talk/what-are-the-best-bras-for-side-set-boobs) and


[close-set breasts](https://www.honeylove.com/blogs/bra-talk/best-bras-for-close-set-breasts) for how to identify which applies.


Do Honeylove bras run true to size?


Most reviewers who measured first say yes. The common adjustment is a snugger band, since a wireless bra relies on the band for support in a way a wired bra does not. Several reviewers went down a band size and up a cup size and called the result perfect. Every bra ships with a hook extender for the in-between cases.


Can you wear a Honeylove bra to the gym?


The CrossFlex Activity Bra is designed for it and has hundreds of reviews covering Pilates, yoga, walking, pickleball, weight lifting and horse riding.


Are Honeylove bras suitable after a mastectomy or breast surgery?


Many reviewers say so explicitly, and the reason is the absence of a rigid wire pressing on scar tissue. The CrossOver, CrossOver V-Neck and CloudEmbrace come up most often in these reviews. This is not medical advice, and anyone recently post-surgery should check with their care team first.


How do you wash a Honeylove bra?


Hand washing is recommended. Every bra ships with a mesh wash bag for machine washing on a cold, delicate cycle, and reviewers who use it report the bras holding shape. Lay flat and air dry.


What is Honeylove's return policy?


Returns and exchanges are free within 30 days. Reviewers describe the exchange process as fast and straightforward, with several noting replacements arriving within a week.
